name: Chaff
author: Erin Carter
description: A low rank of ripe seed-heads leans in from the bottom edge as dim drooping silhouettes that never rise past the frame's lower quarter. Invisible gust fronts sweep across the rank; each head a front bends sheds a few glowing chaff motes that lift, stream downwind on shallow ballistic arcs, tumble and fade before leaving the frame. Every mote's position is a pure function of the shared gust schedule and a per-mote hash, so the field is stateless and seamlessly looping; motes take their hue from their parent head's position along the rank, blending through all four palette colours, while the bent heads catch only a faint rim. Between gusts the air empties back to near-black through long becalmed calms.

params.label: Gust rate
params.effect: How often a gust front crosses the rank and sheds a new drift of chaff; low leaves long becalmed calms, high keeps the air busy with overlapping releases.

params.label: Chaff density
params.effect: Hash-gated fraction of candidate motes that actually release per gust, thinning the drift to a few lonely flecks or filling it out into a thick shed.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: How far downwind and how high the motes are carried before they decelerate and fade; low gives short tumbling hops, high streams them across the field.

params.label: Mote size
params.effect: CSS-pixel size of each chaff fleck, from fine drifting dust to coarse confetti.
